tags.name: The Chosen
tags.sourceDescription:
When supernatural threats converge on McKennitt University, a group of college students must save the world from multiple apocalypses while navigating heritage, romance, loss, and betrayal. Three seasons, three world-ending crises, and one unbreakable bond forged in the literal fires of Armageddon. * Test Episode

tags.name: Season 1
tags.sourceDescription: Two priestesses of the demon Zolor are intent on bringing him back to consume souls in the unsuspecting town of McKennit. A group of students at Phillipi College is the only one who can stop them, while battling a powerful group of vampires known as the Alumni... as well as themselves.

tags.name: Season 2
tags.sourceDescription: The Scoobies learn the true story -- and the true cost -- of the Boyd-Townsend family's rise to power. When the town's foundation is shaken, the solution lies with a most unlikely ally.

tags.name: Season 3
tags.sourceDescription: After three years of manipulation by the enigmatic Bannon, the Scoobies discover they've been pawns in a sinister plan to build an army and unleash an apocalypse. As friends fall to darkness and holy ground is desecrated, the crew must navigate devastating bargains, terrible secrets, and the weight of prophecy. Their final confrontation will determine whether they can break free from Bannon's control—and whether the price of freedom is one they can bear to pay.
